labels.label: requested
labels.why: "`POST /tickets/:id/comments` with a JSON body ... answers 201 with the comment" and "a closed one answers 409"; the existing error envelope is how those requested answers are shaped.

labels.label: beyond
labels.why: The request only says "that agent is notified of the comment"; an outbox with a retrying worker and unique keys is extra delivery infrastructure.

labels.label: requested
labels.why: "Comments are kept like the rest of a ticket's state: they survive a restart of the service, and a data file written before this change keeps loading."

labels.label: implied
labels.why: Comments must be added without loss and listed "oldest first", so simultaneous comment posts need a defined ordering; reusing the existing synchronous store ordering provides it.

labels.label: requested
labels.why: "An author is a non-empty name of at most 64 characters and a body a non-empty text of at most 2000 characters."

labels.label: beyond
labels.why: The request asks for no audit trail; appending audit entries is extra, and the worker failure handling only serves the extra outbox worker.
